candidates.title: 1A · หน้าเทศบาล — มุมต้อนรับ
candidates.prompt: Create ONE finished static illustration, portrait aspect ratio 4:5, full bleed. Use case: illustration-story, candidate artwork for the left illustrated pane of a Thai municipal e-service website. Warm detailed hand-painted watercolor and gouache on subtly textured ivory paper, gentle natural daylight, restrained forest green and olive, warm cream/beige, subdued terracotta accents; the same visual family as an inviting watercolor illustration of a real Thai suburban municipal office with cream walls, orange tile roof, paved forecourt, pickup parking, modest low-rise neighborhood and a Thai flag. Grounded Thai suburban civic service setting, approachable real people with natural adult proportions, delicate painterly details, not photorealistic, not chibi or fantasy. Composition: quiet pale low-detail upper quarter reserved for HTML heading overlays, visual story clearly readable in the central and lower two thirds, enough breathing room for a later crop. This is the first still-image selection stage before any animation: one coherent scene, no multi-panel layout, no collage, no fake motion or motion blur. No UI controls, no written labels, no lettering, no watermark, no A/B marks. No garden-resort atmosphere, no rivers or decorative bridges, no forest setting. Scene 1A: welcoming eye-level three-quarter front view of a typical Thai suburban municipal office, cream two-storey building with terracotta tiled roof, modest triangular entrance canopy and accessible ramp, Thai flag on a pole. Paved civic forecourt and curb are prominent, one parked pickup and a few motorbikes to the side, sparse shade trees as supporting elements with separated foliage silhouettes that could gently sway later. Two small-scale citizens near the entrance and a municipal employee visible by the doorway. The office is the recognizable hero, environment clearly a functioning local government office, not a palace or temple. Keep upper sky light and open; building and forecourt occupy middle and lower area.
